dimensions.assessment: Affects American Indian and Alaska Native patients receiving emergency medical care from non-IHS providers, excluding elderly or disabled individuals.
dimensions.evidence: This bill does not apply to individuals who are elderly or disabled, who continue to have a 30-day notification requirement for emergency services.

dimensions.assessment: Extends the notification window from 72 hours to 15 days, potentially preventing claim denials for missed deadlines.
dimensions.evidence: This bill extends from 72 hours to 15 days the time period to notify the Purchased/Referred Care (PRC) program

dimensions.assessment: May impact the approval and payment of emergency medical claims by the IHS, though exact fiscal amounts are not stated.
Amends Section 406 of the Indian Health Care Improvement Act for specific notification rules.
dimensions.evidence: Section 406 of the Indian Health Care Improvement Act (25 U.S.C. 1646) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Provides a permanent statutory change to notification timeframes.

missing_information: Dollar amounts or overall fiscal impact on federal spending.
importance_detail.rationale: S. 1055 extends the notification timeline for emergency medical claims under the Purchased/Referred Care program for certain beneficiaries, excluding elderly or disabled individuals.
